record.paper_title: Open Problems on Syzygies and Hilbert Functions
record.original_question: If I is generated by generic forms and R = S/I, is the Poincare series of k over R determined by the Hilbert series of R?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be an infinite field, let $S = k[x_1, \dots, x_n]$ be a standard graded polynomial ring, and fix positive integers $d_1, \dots, d_m$. Consider an ideal $I = (f_1, \dots, f_m) \subset S$ generated by generic homogeneous forms with $\deg f_i = d_i$ (i.e., the coefficients of the $f_i$ are general points in the corresponding affine space of coefficients). Set $R = S/I$, viewed as a graded $k$-algebra, and let $k$ denote the residue field $R/\mathfrak{m}$ where $\mathfrak{m}$ is the maximal homogeneous ideal of $R$. Define the graded Poincaré series of $k$ over $R$ by
$$P^R_k(t) \;=\; \sum_{i \ge 0} \dim_k \operatorname{Tor}^R_i(k,k)\, t^i,$$
and let $H_R(t) = \sum_{j \ge 0} \dim_k R_j\, t^j$ denote the Hilbert series of $R$.

Question: For $I$ generated by generic forms as above, is the Poincaré series $P^R_k(t)$ determined solely by the Hilbert series $H_R(t)$ (equivalently, by the numerical data $n$ and $d_1, \dots, d_m$)?
artifact.status_search_result: The question—whether the Poincaré series of $k$ over $R = S/I$ for $I$ generated by generic forms is determined by the Hilbert series of $R$—appears in published lists of open problems on syzygies and Hilbert functions and is closely tied to the still-open Fröberg conjecture on the Hilbert series of generic ideals (which itself is only known in special cases such as $m \le n+1$, equal degrees with $m$ large, and a few low-dimensional regimes). No general resolution of the Poincaré-series question for generic forms appears in the literature, so the problem is regarded as open.

status_evidence.title: On the Hilbert series of ideals generated by generic forms
status_evidence.snippet: Fröberg's conjecture predicts the Hilbert series of an ideal generated by generic forms; it remains open in general.
status_evidence.claim: The underlying Hilbert-series problem for generic forms (Fröberg's conjecture) is still open in general, supporting the open status of the related Poincaré-series question.

status_evidence.title: The initial ideal of generic sequences and Fröberg's Conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: A longstanding conjecture by Fröberg predicts the shape of the Hilbert function of R/I for generic forms; partial results only.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial cases of the generic-forms Hilbert-series problem are known, so finer invariants like the Poincaré series are not generally determined.
